title: Lettres Calvin — digital critical edition of the French correspondence of John Calvin (lettres-calvin)
institution: Independent project (individual researcher; no institutional affiliation stated)
notes:
TEI critical edition of Calvin's French correspondence offering manuscript/print facsimiles, a diplomatic base text (Jules Bonnet's 1854 edition), a modernized French version and a Spanish translation, encoded with a custom TEI ODD schema (msDesc, bibl, ARK/IIIF links) plus an API over the TEI XML files. Independent, non-institutional project: scholarly standing, completeness and letter counts are not stated on the repository and need human review.

Justification: Found via a GitHub web search for TEI critical editions of Renaissance correspondence. A freely accessible, TEI-encoded critical edition of a major 16th-century correspondence corpus (Calvin, c. 1530–1564), squarely within 1450–1700; not in the catalogue (Bullinger Digital is catalogued, Calvin's correspondence is not).
Found at: https://github.com/pippaJeanne/lettres-calvin
